title: Credit Card Payoff Calculator: Months to Pay Off & Interest
description: Free credit card payoff calculator: enter your balance, APR and monthly payment to see how many months it takes, total interest, and the cost of minimums.
lead: How long will it take to pay off your credit card, and how much interest will you pay along the way? Enter your balance, your APR and what you can pay each month, or switch to minimum payments to see the difference.
keywords: how long to pay off credit card
